title: Structural Alignment & Credential Integrity Resolution
summary: Resolved DDD violations regarding UI placement and hardened the credential dual-sync protocol between ~/.zshrc and .env.
key_findings: CivicDashboard.tsx was incorrectly placed in a script directory; relocated to domains/civic/ui/.
Duplicate keys in secrets-sync and setup_credentials scripts were causing configuration drift.
Dual-sync protocol now ensures that derived shell credentials are immediately mirrored to the project environment.
conclusions: Architectural integrity restored. The system is now nominal for Phase 1 testing.
recommendations: Execute deploy-end-to-end.sh to verify full pipeline health.
